rule: Every documentation check family has one primary execution owner. A later release handoff may consume its evidence, but it must not make a passing fast, scheduled, or Chromium lane appear to be a release result.

lanes.check_family: changed source, map, locale peer, fixture, or configuration
lanes.timing: before requesting review for an ordinary scoped documentation edit; bounded to 30 seconds
lanes.progress_evidence: stdout names the selected scope and affected locale/guide/search/output area, lists Skipped release-only checks, and prints make docs-release-handoff as escalation
lanes.escalation: make docs-release-handoff when the release scope or a release-only risk is affected

lanes.check_family: deterministic documentation tooling coverage and non-browser unit/contract partition
lanes.timing: every pull request and push after static analysis
lanes.progress_evidence: the documentation-coverage job log and documentation-coverage-artifacts upload
lanes.escalation: rerun the focused test named by pytest; use the release handoff only for release scope

lanes.check_family: snapshot, index, editorial, localization, and review-record drift audits
lanes.timing: weekly and by manual workflow dispatch; never an ordinary prose-edit prerequisite
lanes.command: documentation-audits workflow: make docs-snapshot plus its declared docs_contract audit selection
lanes.progress_evidence: workflow phase log and the documentation-scheduled-audit-evidence artifact
lanes.escalation: classify the failing audit against its declared owner; run make docs-release-handoff only when the finding affects a release candidate

lanes.check_family: installed portal interaction, responsive rendering, assets, search shell, and /docs coexistence
lanes.timing: every pull request and push after static analysis; immediately for a portal/UI risk
lanes.progress_evidence: chromium-tests log with matching browser/driver paths and chromium-failure-artifacts upload
lanes.escalation: rerun make test-docs-browser with the captured failure artifact; do not substitute a source-only check

lanes.check_family: six-locale release validation, binary PDF build/verification/delivery, reproducibility, package verification, snapshot, and local install proof
lanes.timing: for every documentation release candidate and any change affecting a guide map, localization, presentation, package, PDF, or delivery boundary
lanes.progress_evidence: truthful phase/completed/total/terminal stdout from the owned build, PDF, delivery, reproducibility, package, and install operations
lanes.escalation: the release manager owns candidate disposition; run make test-release separately for the general BPM release suite

nonoverlap.rule: Required pull-request CI invokes each documentation command family once: documentation-coverage owns non-browser deterministic work and chromium-tests owns browser work. docs-release-handoff, PDF, reproducibility, and live Firefox are intentionally outside ordinary pull-request CI.
